newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Wk to date - 133,200 Last Week - 94,100 Year Ago - 70,600
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00, few pens North Plains 1100 lbs 65.00.

Sales reported on 1,400 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers; 133,200 head confirmed for week to date which includes 31,400 formulated cattle and 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
